walkthrough: Goal: colour the inside of my line art flat and fast, fix it when it spills, and find it all again tomorrow.

Entry: open OpenPaint on the tablet (2880 x 1800, landscape) on an empty library and ink with the pen: a closed circle at the left, a closed square at the top right, and below it an arc that does not close. Tap the colour button and the hue ring's red; tap the canvas with a finger to close the panel.

Press the colour button (the red swatch at the top bar's right end) with a finger and drag onto the canvas: after a few points a red drop follows the finger and a pill in the top band reads 'Lift to fill. Hold still to adjust.' Lift inside the circle: the inside turns red up to the line and under its soft inner edge, with no white seam; the line and everything outside stay as they were. The bar now offers 'Continue filling'.
Tap undo in the side bar: the fill goes; redo: it is back. The fill is one step, like a stroke.
Drop red into the arc that does not close: the colour runs out through the gap over the whole paper (no gap closing). Undo it.

Drop red on the paper outside the shapes and hold still: after a moment the fill shows as a preview and the bar reads 'Threshold 60.0 % · slide to adjust'. Slide to the right: the threshold rises (100 % at the far end) and the preview, kept on screen while the next one is computed, takes the lines too. Lift: that fill is kept. Undo it.

Tap 'Continue filling': the bar reads 'Tap an area to fill it.' with Done. Tap inside the square with the pen: it fills red. A finger on the canvas still moves the view. Tap Done; the pen draws again.
Cancel: drag a drop back onto an island or the side bar, or off the canvas onto the desk, and lift: nothing changes.

Failure: open Layers and hide the layer, close the panel, and drop red on the canvas: nothing is filled and the top bar says 'Can't fill: the layer is hidden.' with OK. Show the layer again. A locked layer says it is locked. With Alpha Lock on, a fill colours only the layer's paint (Procreate).
Leave the app and let the system close it, open it again: the fills are there, pixel for pixel. Not here: a fill reference layer, gap closing, filling inside a selection.
